_help: Words for /test-your-product/ (js/biz-test.js). Prices and tiers: test_tiers.json. sample: the made-up sample report (always labelled as a sample).
label: For projects
title: Test it before launch. Real people, real confusion, real fixes.
intro: Real web3 players try your product on a testnet, task by task, with a timer. You see where they finish, where they get stuck and what they say, before your users do.

benefits.title: Real players, not bots
benefits.text: Every tester has earned web3.toys certificates, so they know the basics.

benefits.title: Where people get stuck
benefits.text: Completion rate and time for every task, and exactly where people gave up.

benefits.title: Their words, their screenshots
benefits.text: Short comments and screenshots you can hand straight to your team.

benefits.title: A retest
benefits.text: Fix the worst problem, then we test it again (Standard and up).

benefits.title: Safe by design
benefits.text: Testnets or fresh empty wallets only. Testers never use real funds or recovery phrases.

benefits.title: A branded report
benefits.text: A PDF report you can share with your team and investors.

sampleLine: Made-up data, to show what you get.

tasks.title: Create an account and connect a wallet
Get test tokens from the faucet

Swap worked, the confirmation screen was nice.

steps.title: Request
steps.text: Send the form with your testnet link and the tasks you want tested. Pay a 50% deposit to reserve a slot.

steps.title: We set it up
steps.text: We check your project, write clear tasks with you and open the test to testers who qualify.

steps.title: People test
steps.text: Testers work through each task with a timer, rate it and tell us where they got stuck.

steps.title: Your report
steps.text: You get the report with numbers, quotes and screenshots, and a retest on Standard and up.

rulesTitle: The safety rules every tester follows
rules: Tests use a testnet or a fresh, empty wallet only.
Never enter a recovery (seed) phrase anywhere.
Stop and report it if anything asks for one.
testerTitle: Are you a player? Become a tester
testerLine: Test new web3 products on testnets, get paid in stablecoins for each approved test, plus coins and free full reports. Explorer rank and up.

form.product: What does your product do, in two sentences?
form.launch: When do you launch? (if you know)
form.agree: I understand every project is vetted first, testers only ever use testnets or empty wallets, and the deposit is refunded in full if you decline.

testLink: Link testers should use (testnet or staging)
testTasks: Tasks you want tested, one per line (for example: create an account, make a test swap, find the settings)
afterLine: Reserve your test slot with a 50% deposit, or book a call first.
loginNote: Log in first so you can follow your request. Your answers stay on this page.
